description: Boolean (CSG) of two 3D primitives — Union · Subtract · Difference · Intersection. Wire primitive A into the main input and primitive B into the B input; move B (via Transform 3D) so they overlap.
instructions:
3D CSG of two primitives: the main input is A, the `gin-b` input is the second primitive B. Union (A ∪ B) · Subtract / Difference (A − B) · Intersection (A ∩ B). Wire primitive A into the main input and B into the B input; position B (via a Transform 3D) so the two overlap meaningfully, else the result is empty or unchanged.

TIP: Subtract to carve openings/voids; Intersection to keep only the common volume. Wire the output into Display 3D to style it.
